result.report:
Based on the analysis of 97 nights, your average sleep duration is 8.02 hours with an average quality rating of 6.54. You experienced 11 short nights and a bedtime variation of 29 minutes. Your sleep debt over the last 7 nights against a 8.0 hour target is 1.07 hours.

The habit most linked with worse sleep is screen_min, which has a correlation of -0.611 and a p-value of 0.0005. This is strong evidence of an association. Please note that this is an association and not a cause-and-effect relationship. No relevant past experiments were found.

To explore this further, your suggested experiment is: no screens in the last 60 minutes before bed.

General wellbeing information only, not medical advice. If you have serious or persistent symptoms, see a doctor.
